faq.title: Questions, <red>answered</red>
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about becoming a TradeQuo IB.
faq.1.q: How do I become a TradeQuo IB?
faq.1.a: Open and verify a TradeQuo account, apply to the IB program in your Client Portal, and start sharing your referral link once you’re approved. We review applications within 24 hours.
faq.2.a: Up to 87% of the spread on every trade your referred clients place, for as long as they stay active. There’s no cap on clients or volume.
faq.3.q: When and how do I get paid?
faq.3.a: Every day. Commissions settle at 00:00 server time, and we cover processing and withdrawal fees. Minimum thresholds and supported payout methods are listed in the payout calendar.
faq.4.a: A dedicated partner manager, a live tracking dashboard, ready-made creatives and free education. You can also build a Sub-IB network and earn on the partners you bring in.
faq.5.q: Do I need experience or capital?
faq.5.a: No. There’s no joining fee, and you don’t need capital or trading experience. A verified TradeQuo account is all it takes.
